column1: # Stage S10 H2d, page crate: the doctrine and info pages (the doctrine wiki, the vehicle database
# and the modpacks page) become crates/frontend/pages/doctrine_pages. The folder becomes the crate's
# `src`, its module tree `lib.rs`, and its README the source tree README; the feature docs move to
# their mirror under documentation/crates/frontend/pages/doctrine_pages. The prefix is one `crate::`
# row scoped to the moved folder and one `doctrine_pages::` row scoped to the app's source.
